criteria.requirement: Separate iterator batch validation from side-effect atomicity. Offer a bounded-memory staged/validated input or re-readable preflight plus a real storage transaction or explicit publish boundary. Explain limits for irreversible external writes and define recovery/idempotency; strict chunking alone cannot ensure all-or-nothing.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
